title: 懂朕心者莫若朕的臣弟也凤府千金凤蝶舞
content_zh:
懂朕心者，莫若朕的臣弟也！
御圣君勾了勾唇，唇角的笑意，冷淡中带着一丝悲哀，替自己悲哀，“母后每次前来牡丹亭，都是为皇后的人选，以及子嗣的事而来，也难怪这儿的香味令您头疼。若香味就是儿臣的心，而母后每日都闻到同一种香味，那就表明儿臣的心始终没有变过，否则，母后今日也不会闻到这的香味一如往日，也不会因为这香味而头疼！”
“皇上，”皇太后脸上的锐气减去了几分，看着御圣君鬼斧神工般才能生成的脸，语气也柔了几分，却有着渴望之意，“那你告诉母后，什么时候，你能再立后？”
“呵，”御圣君挑了挑冰冷的唇，语气充满着讽刺，“再立后？母后，您是否忘记得太早了，上个月才立下您选的皇后，结果与人暗结珠胎，私奔而逃，到如今，那二人也未找到一丝踪迹。再立后，难保不会发生这样的事情。不管怎么说，儿臣铁了心找儿臣想要的女人为后，请母后别插手了！”
皇太后目光一凛，放下狠话，“母后可以不插手，但请皇上给个期限，何时立后？”
“一年，”御圣君给出期限，“明年今日，儿臣定立新后！”
“好，就一年的期限，”皇太后倒也爽快，答应了，只是狠话还在后头，“若明年今日，皇上还不立后，就请皇上每夜招后宫嫔妃侍寝吧。”
一会，看着皇太后冷漠离去的身影，御圣君眼中的情绪，复杂了几分。回身，坐下，单手搁在石桌上，明目望着熏香炉内散发出来的烟气，眼中的复杂情绪，渐渐褪去。
不一会，身穿一袭丝质蓝袍的御子尘，轻步走上牡丹亭，“皇兄！”
“坐吧，”御圣君随意摆了摆袖子，示意道。
“谢皇兄。”一声道谢过后，御子尘下摆一甩于身后，坐下了石凳，面向御圣君时，正好捕捉到御圣君正要掩饰掉的一丝惆怅。
君心难测，君心更是不可随意揣测，但作为御圣君最信任的兄弟，御子尘强迫不了自己不去问，“除了承欢皇后与他人私奔之事，恐没有任何事能让皇兄把心悬着，皇兄是否还在为承欢皇后与他人私奔之事而烦忧？”
御圣君眼神深深看着眼前这位同父异母、同一天出生的兄弟，俄顷，突然咧嘴一笑，矫正的皓齿微露，大有释怀之意，在外人面前，这释怀之笑，恐无人目睹过。“懂朕心者，莫若朕的臣弟也！”
御子尘略微笑笑，有点受宠若惊，“皇兄抬举了。”
慢慢的，御圣君的笑容止住，惆怅的目光，落在了亭外的牡丹花间，“二弟，朕羡慕你与官萼云之间的爱，你们从相遇，相知，相爱，到相守，每一步都走得很幸福。而朕，始终没能遇上朕一生想爱的女子。”
消化完御圣君的话后，御子尘眼中划过一丝狡黠之色，“皇兄，您是否还会微服私访民间？臣弟与萼云是在民间相识，从此萼云便是臣弟心中的至爱，想必，皇兄的至爱不在于后宫，想必是在民间，皇兄可愿意出宫亲自去寻找未来的皇后？当然，不是承欢皇后！”
“这……”御圣君犹豫了，但一想到一年后要给皇太后一个新皇后，不再犹豫，“二弟，朕听你的，响午动身出宫！”
“好咧！”御子尘高兴而应，又一抹狡黠的光芒划过眼中，只是御圣君没有捕捉到。
content_en:
The one who understands my heart is none other than my younger brother!
Yu Shengjun curled his lips, and the smile on his lips was cold and tinged with sadness, feeling sad for himself, "Every time my mother comes to the Peony Pavilion, she comes to choose the queen and to discuss the issue of her heirs. It's no wonder that the fragrance here gives you a headache. If the fragrance is the son's heart, and the mother smells the same fragrance every day, it means that the son's heart has never changed. Otherwise, the mother will not smell the fragrance today as before, and she will not have a headache because of the fragrance! "
"Your Majesty," the sharpness on the Empress Dowager's face lost a bit. Looking at the uncanny face of the Royal Saint, her tone became a bit softer, but with a hint of longing, "Then tell your mother, when will you be able to become a queen again?"
"Ha," Yu Shengjun raised his cold lips, his tone full of sarcasm, "Make a queen again? Queen Mother, have you forgotten too early? You just made the queen you chose last month, and ended up secretly getting married and eloping with someone. Until now, there is no trace of the two people. There is no guarantee that such a thing will not happen again. In any case, I am determined to find the woman I want to be my queen. Please don't interfere, Queen Mother!"
The Empress Dowager's eyes were sharp, and she put down her harsh words, "The Empress does not have to interfere, but please give me a time limit, when will the Queen be crowned?"
"One year," Yu Shengjun gave the deadline. "Today next year, I will appoint a new queen!"
"Okay, it's just a one-year period," the Empress Dowager agreed readily, but the harsh words came later, "If the Emperor doesn't have a queen by today next year, please ask the Emperor to recruit concubines from the harem to sleep with you every night."
After a while, watching the empress dowager leave indifferently, the emotions in Yu Shengjun's eyes became a little more complicated. He turned around, sat down, put one hand on the stone table, and stared at the smoke coming out of the incense burner. The complicated emotions in his eyes gradually faded away.
After a while, Yu Zichen, wearing a silk blue robe, walked lightly onto the Peony Pavilion and said, "Brother Emperor!"
"Sit down," Yu Shengjun casually waved his sleeves and gestured.
"Thank you, Brother Huang." After thanking him, Yu Zichen swung his skirt behind him and sat down on the stone bench. When he faced Yu Shengjun, he caught a hint of melancholy that Yu Shengjun was about to hide.
The emperor's heart is unpredictable, and the emperor's heart cannot be speculated at will. However, as Yu Shengjun's most trusted brother, Yu Zichen could not force himself not to ask, "Except for Queen Chenghuan's elopement with others, there is probably nothing that can make the emperor's brother worried. Is the emperor's brother still worried about Queen Chenghuan's elopement with others?"
Yu Shengjun looked deeply at the half brother in front of him, who was born on the same day. After a while, he suddenly grinned, his straight teeth slightly exposed, showing a sense of relief. In front of outsiders, this smile of relief may have been witnessed by no one. "The one who understands my heart is none other than my younger brother!"
Yu Zichen smiled slightly, feeling a little flattered, "Your Majesty, you are so flattered."
Slowly, Yu Shengjun's smile stopped, and his melancholy eyes fell on the peonies outside the pavilion. "Second brother, I envy the love between you and Guan Eyun. From meeting, getting to know each other, falling in love, and staying together, you have been very happy every step of the way. But I have never been able to meet the woman I want to love in my life."
After digesting Yu Shengjun's words, Yu Zichen's eyes flashed with a cunning look, "Brother Emperor, will you still visit the people privately incognito? My brother and Cai Yun met in the public, and Cai Yun has been the love in my heart since then. Presumably, the emperor's love does not lie in the harem, but among the people. Is the emperor willing to go out of the palace to find the future queen in person? Of course, it is not Queen Chenghuan!"
"This..." Yu Shengjun hesitated, but when he thought about giving the Empress Dowager a new queen in a year, he no longer hesitated, "Second brother, I will listen to you and leave the palace at noon!"
"Okay!" Yu Zichen responded happily, and another cunning light flashed across his eyes, but Yu Shengjun did not catch it.
